title: ENZYME AGENT FOR PROTEIN DEAMIDATION AND PROTEIN CROSSLINKING AND USE THEREOF
abstract: The problem addressed by the present invention is to provide an enzyme agent for protein deamidation and protein crosslinking containing an enzyme having protein deamidation activity and transglutaminase activity, and the use thereof. The present invention provides an enzyme agent for protein deamidation and protein crosslinking that contains as an active ingredient an enzyme having protein deamidation activity and transglutaminase activity comprising an amino acid sequence having 90% or more sequence identity with the amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO: 1.

title: SUSPENSION CULTURES
abstract: The present disclosure relates to cell cultures, and in particular, to cell cultures comprising cells that are capable of anchorage-independent growth. In some aspects, ZIC1 activity has been suppressed or inactivated in the cells. The cells described herein may have several applications, including in the production of comestible products and therapeutic products.

title: MOBILE BIOREACTOR SERVICE SYSTEM
abstract: A mobile bioreactor service system includes a control interface, a physical interface, and a service system. The control interface connects to one or more valves. The physical interface connects one or more tubes to a bioreactor enabling process fluids to be physically transferred to/from the bioreactor based on a corresponding state of the one or more valves. The service system performs a service on the bioreactor.
